name: Ripple
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
      Ripple automata simulation.;
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Ripple" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.3
      </param>
      <param name="clampMin">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="clampMax">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="diffusion">
        0.08
      </param>
      <param name="damp">
        0.9
      </param>
      <param name="sub_a">
        0.1
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
c = clamp( a, 0.0, 1.0 );
a = clamp( a + laplacian_a * diffusion, 0.0, 1.0);
b = c;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="false">
      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-1" high="1">
          
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.1" y="0.1" z="0.1">
            
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.9" y="0.9" z="0.9">
            
          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-1" high="1">
          
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.05" y="0.05" z="0.05">
            
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.95" y="0.95" z="0.95">
            
          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite>
          
        </overwrite>
        <white_noise low="-1" high="1">
          
        </white_noise>
        <rectangle>
          <point3D x="0.15" y="0.15" z="0.15">
            
          </point3D>
          <point3D x="0.85" y="0.85" z="0.85">
            
          </point3D>
          
        </rectangle>
        
      </overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    <render_settings>
      <surface_color r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </surface_color>
      <color_low r="0" g="0" b="0">
        
      </color_low>
      <color_high r="1" g="1" b="1">
        
      </color_high>
      <show_color_scale value="false">
        
      </show_color_scale>
      <show_multiple_chemicals value="true">
        
      </show_multiple_chemicals>
      <active_chemical value="a">
        
      </active_chemical>
      <low value="0">
        
      </low>
      <high value="1">
        
      </high>
      <vertical_scale_1D value="30">
        
      </vertical_scale_1D>
      <vertical_scale_2D value="30">
        
      </vertical_scale_2D>
      <contour_level value="0">
        
      </contour_level>
      <use_wireframe value="false">
        
      </use_wireframe>
      <show_cell_edges value="false">
        
      </show_cell_edges>
      <show_bounding_box value="true">
        
      </show_bounding_box>
      <slice_3D value="true">
        
      </slice_3D>
      <slice_3D_axis value="z">
        
      </slice_3D_axis>
      <slice_3D_position value="0.5">
        
      </slice_3D_position>
      <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="false">
        
      </show_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="true">
        
      </color_displacement_mapped_surface>
      <use_image_interpolation value="true">
        
      </use_image_interpolation>
      <timesteps_per_render value="1">
        
      </timesteps_per_render>
      
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 511 0 511 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
